TYPE CHECK: The candidate value "HeLa" is a named immortalized cell line, which matches the field definition.
SOURCE CHECK: The paper mentions HeLa cells in the context of mRNA export assays (FISH and RT-qPCR), but the proteomics analysis was performed using "API5 knockout cells" (generated via CRISPR/Cas9) into which FLAG-tagged API5 WT or 4Mut were reconstituted. While the paper does not explicitly name the parent cell line for the knockout cells, the "Bulk mRNA export assay" section explicitly states that the shRNA system was developed in "HeLa cells," and the "Other biochemical and cellular experiments" section mentions cell line authentication. However, the proteomics experiment specifically used the API5 knockout cells.
TRUTH CHECK: The proteomics analysis was performed on API5 knockout cells. The text indicates that the shRNA-mediated depletion and subsequent mRNA export assays were done in HeLa cells. It is highly probable the knockout cells were also derived from HeLa, but the text explicitly links the "proteomics analysis" to the "API5 knockout cells" used for the interactome study.
COMPLETENESS CHECK: The full set contains only "HeLa". If the knockout cells were derived from HeLa, this is correct.
